decisions.reason: The Android modernization changes are already captured by a separate same-message MODIFY; the iOS version and UIWebView changes require no further Android state change.
The privacy-manifest obligation is already established by its own same-message Event and is not changed by the iOS version or UIWebView requirements.
Signing-certificate renewal is already established separately and remains unchanged by the iOS modernization value change.
Android permission compliance is already captured by its own same-message Event and is unaffected by the iOS-specific modernization changes.
Full-app localization was resolved before the source Event and does not change because iOS 15+ support and UIWebView replacement were accepted.
The Android size optimizations are already captured by a separate same-message MODIFY and are not altered by the iOS-specific modernization changes.
The existing iOS Thinning requirement remains valid unchanged; the source decision does not add, replace, or remove its distribution method.
Android localization coverage was resolved independently and is unaffected by the iOS version and UIWebView changes.
At message 38 the remain-or-remove choice was still unresolved; the iOS modernization change does not resolve or modify the Android Youku-video requirement.
The iOS download-size optimization goal remains unchanged and is not necessarily modified by setting iOS 15+ support or replacing UIWebView.
RTL layout support remains valid unchanged; the source decision does not alter its behavior, scope, or attributes.
Android RTL support is independent of the accepted iOS modernization details and remains unchanged.
